## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's missing or awkward today? A concrete workflow or use
case helps ("I was running `/datalab:...` and needed to ...").

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like. If it touches a specific command, skill, script,
or template, name it.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, links to similar tools/prior art, related issues.
